channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Here’s the inflation breakdown for August 2026 — in one chart
item.description: Inflation remained stubbornly high in August, largely on the back of higher energy prices amid the Iran war, economists said.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shut down East-West crude oil pipeline after multiple attacks by drones from Iraq
item.description: Iran-allied Houthi militants in Yemen have escalated strikes on Saudi Arabia this week.

item.title: I went to Caracas for Venezuela’s new oil deals. Here’s what stood out
item.description: CNBC was one of just a handful of news organizations allowed to travel to Caracas with the U.S. secretary of energy.

item.title: Dow rises 500 points to snap 4-day slide as oil cools, traders look past inflation report: Live updates
item.description: Stocks rose Friday, with investors looking to recover from four straight days of declines, as oil prices retreated.

item.title: Dell stock jumps on RBC initiation, now up nearly 350% in 2026
item.description: Dell sold about $16.4 billion of AI servers in its second quarter, RBC said.

item.title: This logistics company’s growth is hiding in its pipeline. Investors have a chance to be early to the upside
item.description: The company's new CEO is prioritizing organic growth over acquisitions and could share fresh targets at an investor day this fall.

item.title: Dan Chung rebuilt a decimated Alger Management after 9/11. He's still finding the market's winners
item.description: The CEO and chief investment officer at Fred Alger Management survived the attack by chance. He was tasked with reconstruction after 35 staffers died.

item.title: Election officials ban certain public workers from trading on prediction markets ahead of midterms
item.description: Ahead of the midterms, election officials ban certain workers from using prediction markets to reassure the public they are committed to election integrity.

item.title: Arizona accuses L'Oreal of concealing cancer risks linked to hair relaxers
item.description: Arizona sued L'Oreal, saying the company violated laws by marketing hair relaxer products without disclosing alleged cancer risks, joining many user lawsuits.

item.title: Tesla eyes European freight market with long-delayed Semi truck
item.description: Tesla is set to deploy its Semi truck in Europe, releasing details about truck specifications and launch plans in a post on X, after years of delays.

item.title: 25 years after 9/11, the U.S. starts rolling back travel restrictions, from liquids to gate access
item.description: Years after 9/11, the U.S. government is walking back some security screenings as threats and technology evolve.

item.title: In pictures: The U.S. commemorates the 25th anniversary of 9/11
item.description: On Sept. 11, 2001, hijackers flew planes into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing thousands. Photos capture those marking the 25th anniversary.

item.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Falling oil could help stocks but Fed is the next big test
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said falling oil prices helped fuel Friday’s rebound, but warned next week’s Federal Reserve meeting will be the next test for stocks.

item.title: AI fears have hit this data stock. Investor Sarat Sethi sees a buying opportunity
item.description: Verisk Analytics is a leading data and software provider to the insurance industry, with hard-to-replicate data and a recurring revenue model that make its business difficult to disrupt.

item.title: Bonds are going on tilt. How to play them, says Mike Khouw
item.description: Warren Buffett once said interest rates are to asset prices what gravity is to matter. If the options market is correct, things could get heavy, says Mike Khouw.

item.title: Social Security COLA for 2027 may be 3.5% to 3.6%, new estimates show — the highest in 3 years
item.description: New government inflation data points to a higher Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027. Here's what experts estimate the change may be.

item.title: Iran, Russia condemn Western economic sanctions and urge BRICS bloc to deepen economic ties
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized Western sanctions and asked the BRICS bloc to deepen trade ties.

item.title: Record U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak is over, CDC says
item.description: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

item.title: Wealthy investors are pouring billions into this new tax strategy despite risks
item.description: Total assets invested in so-called tax-aware long-short strategies — or TALS — have surged to more than $170 billion, according to Tax Alpha Insider.

item.title: Sub-$100 smartphones becoming a rarity as AI memory prices soar
item.description: The days of the sub-$100 smartphone may be numbered, including in China.

item.title: Why this industrial gas giant deserves its premium valuation (and should be owned)
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch, an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: The price of pet ownership is rising. These credit cards offer perks, from complimentary pet insurance to cash back on vet visits
item.description: The price of pet ownership is rising. These credit cards offer perks, from complimentary pet insurance to cash back on vet visits.

item.title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness is active in options market, sources say
item.description: Situational Awareness has been buying options positions in stocks including Advanced Micro Devices, Bloom Energy and Coreweave, sources told CNBC's David Faber.

item.title: Houthis reportedly advance to key Red Sea island, further threatening crucial oil choke point
item.description: The advance raises the threat to shipping near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a waterway that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden to global markets.

item.title: UAE plans $46 billion investment in Germany, with data centers a key focus
item.description: The UAE plans to invest 40 billion euros ($46.4 billion) in Germany, with data center infrastructure a key part of the package.

item.title: Treasury yields remain near multiyear highs as August CPI shows sticky inflation
item.description: Treasury yields remained near multiyear highs as investors weighed the impact of the latest consumer price report for August.

item.title: AI regulation calls grow in DC after researcher's extinction warning
item.description: Members of Congress are calling for AI regulation after a researcher warned that OpenAI and Anthropic are acting irresponsibly.

item.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

item.title: NYC's 'Baklava Guy' started selling Turkish pastries as 'a joke,' now it brings in $20K/month: 'It's my whole life'
item.description: The 30-year-old entrepreneur behind Good Baklava went viral for handing out free pastries after New York Knicks games and selling to strangers in local parks.

item.title: Oil prices fall Friday, but post sharp weekly gains as tensions in the Middle East rise
item.description: The decline snapped multiday winning streaks for both Brent and WTI crude oil futures.
